# Create Script 1: termux_civilization_setup.sh - Complete Termux Environment Setup

setup_script = '''#!/bin/bash

# ==============================================================================
# THE NEW CIVILIZATION - Termux Setup Script
# Ultra-Lightweight AI/ML/DL Environment for Mobile Revolution
# ==============================================================================

echo "🚀 THE NEW CIVILIZATION - TERMUX SETUP STARTING..."
echo "========================================================"

# Colors for output
RED='\\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\\033[0;34m'
PURPLE='\\033[0;35m'
NC='\\033[0m' # No Color

print_status() {
    echo -e "${GREEN}✅ $1${NC}"
}

print_warning() {
    echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠️  $1${NC}"
}

print_error() {
    echo -e "${RED}❌ $1${NC}"
}

print_info() {
    echo -e "${BLUE}ℹ️  $1${NC}"
}

# Function to check if command exists
command_exists() {
    command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1
}

# Phase 1: System Update and Core Package Installation
echo -e "${PURPLE}📦 Phase 1: Core System Setup${NC}"
echo "----------------------------------------"

print_info "Updating Termux packages..."
pkg update -y && pkg upgrade -y
print_status "Package system updated"

# Install essential packages (ultra-lightweight approach)
ESSENTIAL_PACKAGES=(
    "python"
    "python-pip"
    "git"
    "curl"
    "wget"
    "nodejs"
    "nano"
    "vim"
    "openssh"
    "rsync"
    "zip"
    "unzip"
)

print_info "Installing essential packages..."
for package in "${ESSENTIAL_PACKAGES[@]}"; do
    if ! command_exists "$package"; then
        pkg install -y "$package"
        print_status "Installed $package"
    else
        print_status "$package already installed"
    fi
done

# Setup storage access
print_info "Setting up storage access..."
if [ ! -d "$HOME/storage" ]; then
    termux-setup-storage
    print_status "Storage access configured"
else
    print_status "Storage access already configured"
fi

# Phase 2: Python Environment Setup
echo -e "${PURPLE}🐍 Phase 2: Python AI/ML Environment${NC}"
echo "----------------------------------------"

# Upgrade pip
python -m pip install --upgrade pip

# Install Hugging Face ecosystem (lightweight)
HF_PACKAGES=(
    "huggingface_hub"
    "transformers[torch]"
    "datasets"
    "gradio"
    "accelerate"
    "evaluate"
    "peft"
    "trl"
)

print_info "Installing Hugging Face ecosystem..."
for package in "${HF_PACKAGES[@]}"; do
    pip install "$package" --no-cache-dir
    print_status "Installed $package"
done

# Install additional AI/ML packages (lightweight selection)
ADDITIONAL_PACKAGES=(
    "requests"
    "python-dotenv"
    "schedule"
    "click"
    "rich"
    "typer"
    "fastapi"
    "uvicorn"
    "pillow"
    "opencv-python-headless"
    "matplotlib"
    "seaborn"
    "plotly"
    "streamlit"
)

print_info "Installing additional packages..."
for package in "${ADDITIONAL_PACKAGES[@]}"; do
    pip install "$package" --no-cache-dir
    print_status "Installed $package"
done

# Phase 3: Project Structure Creation
echo -e "${PURPLE}📁 Phase 3: Project Structure Setup${NC}"
echo "----------------------------------------"

# Create main project directory
PROJECT_DIR="$HOME/storage/shared/the_new_civilization"
mkdir -p "$PROJECT_DIR"

# Create subdirectories
DIRECTORIES=(
    "scripts"
    "config"
    "data/raw"
    "data/processed"
    "models/local"
    "models/trained"
    "logs"
    "docs"
    "spaces"
    "repositories"
    "business/clients"
    "business/revenue"
    "interfaces"
    "automation"
)

for dir in "${DIRECTORIES[@]}"; do
    mkdir -p "$PROJECT_DIR/$dir"
    print_status "Created directory: $dir"
done

# Phase 4: Configuration Files
echo -e "${PURPLE}⚙️  Phase 4: Configuration Setup${NC}"
echo "----------------------------------------"

# Create environment configuration
cat > "$PROJECT_DIR/config/.env.template" << 'EOF'
# Hugging Face Configuration
HF_TOKEN=your_hugging_face_token_here
HF_USERNAME=your_username

# API Configuration
OPENAI_API_KEY=your_openai_key_here
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=your_anthropic_key_here

# Business Configuration
BUSINESS_EMAIL=your_business_email@example.com
WEBHOOK_URL=your_webhook_url_here

# Deployment Configuration
SPACES_VISIBILITY=public
REPO_TYPE=model

# Revenue Configuration
PRICING_TIER=premium
CURRENCY=USD
EOF
print_status "Environment template created"

# Create main configuration file
cat > "$PROJECT_DIR/config/civilization_config.py" << 'EOF'
"""
The New Civilization - Main Configuration
Ultra-lightweight configuration for Hugging Face ecosystem
"""

import os
from pathlib import Path
from dotenv import load_dotenv

# Load environment variables
load_dotenv()

class CivilizationConfig:
    """Main configuration class for The New Civilization"""
    
    # Project paths
    BASE_DIR = Path.home() / "storage" / "shared" / "the_new_civilization"
    SCRIPTS_DIR = BASE_DIR / "scripts"
    DATA_DIR = BASE_DIR / "data"
    MODELS_DIR = BASE_DIR / "models"
    LOGS_DIR = BASE_DIR / "logs"
    
    # Hugging Face configuration
    HF_TOKEN = os.getenv("HF_TOKEN")
    HF_USERNAME = os.getenv("HF_USERNAME")
    HF_API_BASE = "https://api-inference.huggingface.co"
    
    # Model configuration
    DEFAULT_MODELS = {
        "text_generation": "microsoft/DialoGPT-medium",
        "text_classification": "cardiffnlp/twitter-roberta-base-sentiment-latest",
        "summarization": "facebook/bart-large-cnn",
        "translation": "Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-en-id",
        "image_generation": "runwayml/stable-diffusion-v1-5",
        "speech_to_text": "openai/whisper-base"
    }
    
    # Business configuration
    REVENUE_MODELS = {
        "content_automation": {"min": 50, "max": 200},
        "api_services": {"min": 0.01, "max": 0.10},
        "custom_solutions": {"min": 500, "max": 2000}
    }
    
    # Deployment configuration
    SPACES_CONFIG = {
        "visibility": "public",
        "sdk": "gradio",
        "python_version": "3.10"
    }

# Initialize configuration
config = CivilizationConfig()
EOF
print_status "Main configuration created"

# Phase 5: Quick Start Script
echo -e "${PURPLE}🚀 Phase 5: Quick Start Tools${NC}"
echo "----------------------------------------"

# Create quick start script
cat > "$PROJECT_DIR/quick_start.py" << 'EOF'

The New Civilization - Quick Start Script
Launch your AI civilization in minutes
"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path
from rich.console import Console
from rich.panel import Panel

    # Welcome message
    title = Text("🌟 THE NEW CIVILIZATION 🌟", style="bold magenta")
    subtitle = Text("Hugging Face-Powered AI Revolution", style="cyan")
    
    welcome_panel = Panel(
        f"{title}\\n{subtitle}\\n\\n"
        "🚀 Ultra-lightweight AI/ML/DL platform\\n"
        "🤖 100,000+ Hugging Face models\\n"
        "💰 Revenue-ready business automation\\n"
        "📱 Optimized for mobile development",
        title="Welcome",
        border_style="green"
    )
    
    console.print(welcome_panel)
    
    # Check configuration
    config_path = Path.home() / "storage" / "shared" / "the_new_civilization" / "config" / ".env"
    
    if not config_path.exists():

    console.print("\\n✅ [green]Environment ready![/green]")
    console.print("\\n🔥 [bold red]Available Commands:[/bold red]")
    console.print("   • python scripts/civilization_hf_orchestrator.py - Main orchestrator")
    console.print("   • python scripts/ai_model_trainer.py - Train custom models")  
    console.print("   • python scripts/spaces_deployment_manager.py - Deploy to Spaces")
    console.print("   • python scripts/civilization_business_engine.py - Revenue automation")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
EOF
print_status "Quick start script created"

# Phase 6: Verification and Final Setup
echo -e "${PURPLE}🔍 Phase 6: System Verification${NC}"
echo "----------------------------------------"

# Verify installations
print_info "Verifying installations..."

# Check Python
if command_exists python; then
    PYTHON_VERSION=$(python --version)
    print_status "Python: $PYTHON_VERSION"
else
    print_error "Python installation failed"
fi

# Check pip packages
pip list | grep -E "(transformers|gradio|huggingface)" > /dev/null
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    print_status "Hugging Face packages installed"
else
    print_warning "Some Hugging Face packages may be missing"
fi

# Check project structure
if [ -d "$PROJECT_DIR" ]; then
    print_status "Project structure created"
    print_info "Project location: $PROJECT_DIR"
else
    print_error "Project structure creation failed"
fi

# Final message
echo -e "${PURPLE}🎉 THE NEW CIVILIZATION SETUP COMPLETE!${NC}"
echo "========================================"
echo ""
echo -e "${GREEN}✅ Next Steps:${NC}"
echo "1. Configure your .env file with API tokens"
echo "2. Run: cd $PROJECT_DIR"
echo "3. Run: python quick_start.py"
echo "4. Start building your AI civilization!"
echo ""
echo -e "${BLUE}📚 Documentation:${NC}"
echo "• README.md - Complete setup guide"
echo "• docs/ - Technical documentation"
echo "• examples/ - Usage examples"
echo ""
echo -e "${YELLOW}💰 Revenue Opportunities:${NC}"
echo "• Content automation: $50-200/article"
echo "• API services: $0.01-0.10/request"
echo "• Custom solutions: $500-2000/project"
echo ""
echo -e "${RED}🚀 Ready to revolutionize the world with AI!${NC}"
'''

# Write the setup script
with open(f"{base_path}/scripts/termux_civilization_setup.sh", "w") as f:
    f.write(setup_script)

print("✅ termux_civilization_setup.sh created successfully!")

# Create Script 2: civilization_hf_orchestrator.py - Main Hugging Face Orchestration System

orchestrator_script = '''#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
THE NEW CIVILIZATION - Hugging Face Orchestrator
Main orchestration system for coordinating all AI operations

This is the heart of The New Civilization - managing and orchestrating
all Hugging Face operations through a unified, intelligent system.
"""

import os
import sys
import json
import time
import logging
import asyncio
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Any
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum

import requests
from huggingface_hub import HfApi, login, logout
from transformers import pipeline, AutoTokenizer, AutoModel
from rich.console import Console
from rich.table import Table
from rich.panel import Panel
from rich.progress import Progress
from rich.live import Live

# Configuration
sys.path.append(str(Path.home() / "storage" / "shared" / "the_new_civilization" / "config"))
try:
    from civilization_config import config
except ImportError:
    print("❌ Configuration not found! Run termux_civilization_setup.sh first.")
    sys.exit(1)

console = Console()

class TaskType(Enum):
    """Supported AI task types"""
    TEXT_GENERATION = "text-generation"
    TEXT_CLASSIFICATION = "text-classification"
    SUMMARIZATION = "summarization"
    TRANSLATION = "translation"
    QUESTION_ANSWERING = "question-answering"
    IMAGE_GENERATION = "text-to-image"
    SPEECH_TO_TEXT = "speech-to-text"
    TOKEN_CLASSIFICATION = "token-classification"
    FILL_MASK = "fill-mask"

@dataclass
class AIRequest:
    """AI processing request structure"""
    task_type: TaskType
    input_data: Any
    model_name: Optional[str] = None
    parameters: Optional[Dict] = None
    priority: int = 1
    client_id: Optional[str] = None
    
class CivilizationOrchestrator:
    """Main orchestration system for The New Civilization"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        """Initialize the orchestrator"""
        self.console = console
        self.hf_api = HfApi()
        self.active_pipelines = {}
        self.request_queue = []
        self.processing_stats = {
            "total_requests": 0,
            "successful_requests": 0,
            "failed_requests": 0,
            "revenue_generated": 0.0
        }
        
        # Setup logging
        self._setup_logging()
        
        # Authenticate with Hugging Face
        self._authenticate()
        
        self.logger.info("🚀 Civilization Orchestrator initialized")
    
    def _setup_logging(self):
        """Setup logging system"""
        log_dir = config.LOGS_DIR
        log_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        
        logging.basicConfig(
            level=logging.INFO,
            format='%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s',
            handlers=[
                logging.FileHandler(log_dir / "orchestrator.log"),
                logging.StreamHandler()
            ]
        )
        self.logger = logging.getLogger("CivilizationOrchestrator")
    
    def _authenticate(self):
        """Authenticate with Hugging Face"""
        if config.HF_TOKEN:
            try:
                login(token=config.HF_TOKEN)
                self.logger.info("✅ Authenticated with Hugging Face")
            except Exception as e:
                self.logger.error(f"❌ Authentication failed: {e}")
        else:
            self.logger.warning("⚠️ No HF_TOKEN found - some features may be limited")
    
    def load_model_pipeline(self, task_type: TaskType, model_name: Optional[str] = None) -> Any:
        """Load a model pipeline for specific task"""
        try:
            # Use default model if none specified
            if not model_name:
                model_name = config.DEFAULT_MODELS.get(task_type.value)
            
            # Check if pipeline already loaded
            cache_key = f"{task_type.value}_{model_name}"
            if cache_key in self.active_pipelines:
                return self.active_pipelines[cache_key]
            
            self.logger.info(f"📥 Loading {task_type.value} pipeline: {model_name}")
            
            # Load pipeline
            pipe = pipeline(task_type.value, model=model_name)
            self.active_pipelines[cache_key] = pipe
            
            self.logger.info(f"✅ Pipeline loaded: {model_name}")
            return pipe
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"❌ Failed to load pipeline {model_name}: {e}")
            return None
    
    def process_request(self, request: AIRequest) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Process a single AI request"""
        try:
            self.processing_stats["total_requests"] += 1
            
            self.logger.info(f"🔄 Processing {request.task_type.value} request")
            
            # Load appropriate pipeline
            pipeline_obj = self.load_model_pipeline(request.task_type, request.model_name)
            if not pipeline_obj:
                raise Exception("Failed to load pipeline")
            
            # Process the request
            start_time = time.time()
            
            if request.parameters:
                result = pipeline_obj(request.input_data, **request.parameters)
            else:
                result = pipeline_obj(request.input_data)
            
            processing_time = time.time() - start_time
            
            # Calculate revenue
            revenue = self._calculate_revenue(request.task_type, processing_time)
            self.processing_stats["revenue_generated"] += revenue
            self.processing_stats["successful_requests"] += 1
            
            response = {
                "status": "success",
                "result": result,
                "processing_time": processing_time,
                "revenue": revenue,
                "model_used": request.model_name or config.DEFAULT_MODELS.get(request.task_type.value),
                "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat()
            }
            
            self.logger.info(f"✅ Request processed in {processing_time:.2f}s - Revenue: ${revenue:.4f}")
            return response
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.processing_stats["failed_requests"] += 1
            self.logger.error(f"❌ Request failed: {e}")
            
            return {
                "status": "error",
                "error": str(e),
                "timestamp": datetime.now().isoformat()
            }
    
    def _calculate_revenue(self, task_type: TaskType, processing_time: float) -> float:
        """Calculate revenue based on task type and processing time"""
        base_rates = {
            TaskType.TEXT_GENERATION: 0.05,
            TaskType.TEXT_CLASSIFICATION: 0.01,
            TaskType.SUMMARIZATION: 0.03,
            TaskType.TRANSLATION: 0.02,
            TaskType.IMAGE_GENERATION: 0.10,
            TaskType.SPEECH_TO_TEXT: 0.04
        }
        
        base_rate = base_rates.get(task_type, 0.02)
        complexity_multiplier = min(processing_time * 0.1, 2.0)  # Max 2x multiplier
        
        return base_rate * (1 + complexity_multiplier)
    
    def batch_process(self, requests: List[AIRequest]) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
        """Process multiple requests in batch"""
        results = []
        
        with Progress() as progress:
            task = progress.add_task(f"[cyan]Processing {len(requests)} requests...", total=len(requests))
            
            for request in requests:
                result = self.process_request(request)
                results.append(result)
                progress.advance(task)
        
        return results
    
    def get_available_models(self, task_type: TaskType, limit: int = 10) -> List[str]:
        """Get available models for specific task type"""
        try:
            models = list(self.hf_api.list_models(
                filter=task_type.value,
                limit=limit,
                sort="downloads",
                direction=-1
            ))
            
            return [model.modelId for model in models]
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"❌ Failed to get models: {e}")
            return []
    
    def display_status(self):
        """Display current system status"""
        # Create status table
        table = Table(title="🌟 The New Civilization - System Status")

    def start_interactive_mode(self):
        """Start interactive mode for testing"""
        self.console.print(Panel(
            "🚀 [bold magenta]THE NEW CIVILIZATION[/bold magenta]\\n"
            "Interactive AI Orchestrator\\n\\n"
            "Available commands:\\n"
            "• [cyan]text[/cyan] - Text generation\\n"
            "• [cyan]classify[/cyan] - Text classification\\n"
            "• [cyan]summarize[/cyan] - Text summarization\\n"
            "• [cyan]translate[/cyan] - Text translation\\n"

            "• [cyan]models[/cyan] - List available models\\n"
            "• [cyan]quit[/cyan] - Exit",
            title="Interactive Mode",
            border_style="green"
        ))
        
        while True:
            try:
                command = self.console.input("\\n[bold cyan]Enter command:[/bold cyan] ").strip().lower()
                
                if command == "quit":
                    break
                elif command == "status":
                    self.display_status()
                elif command == "models":
                    self._show_models_menu()
                elif command == "text":
                    self._handle_text_generation()
                elif command == "classify":
                    self._handle_text_classification()
                elif command == "summarize":
                    self._handle_summarization()
                elif command == "translate":
                    self._handle_translation()
                else:
                    self.console.print("[red]Unknown command. Type 'quit' to exit.[/red]")
                    
            except KeyboardInterrupt:
                self.console.print("\\n[yellow]Interrupted by user[/yellow]")
                break
            except Exception as e:
                self.console.print(f"[red]Error: {e}[/red]")
    
    def _show_models_menu(self):
        """Show available models for different tasks"""
        for task_type in [TaskType.TEXT_GENERATION, TaskType.TEXT_CLASSIFICATION, 
                         TaskType.SUMMARIZATION, TaskType.TRANSLATION]:
            models = self.get_available_models(task_type, 5)
            if models:
                self.console.print(f"\\n[bold]{task_type.value}:[/bold]")
                for model in models[:3]:
                    self.console.print(f"  • {model}")
    
    def _handle_text_generation(self):
        """Handle text generation request"""
        text = self.console.input("Enter prompt: ")
        if text.strip():
            request = AIRequest(
                task_type=TaskType.TEXT_GENERATION,
                input_data=text,
                parameters={"max_length": 100, "num_return_sequences": 1}
            )
            
            result = self.process_request(request)
            if result["status"] == "success":
                self.console.print(f"\\n[green]Generated text:[/green] {result['result'][0]['generated_text']}")
            else:
                self.console.print(f"[red]Error: {result['error']}[/red]")
    
    def _handle_text_classification(self):
        """Handle text classification request"""
        text = self.console.input("Enter text to classify: ")
        if text.strip():
            request = AIRequest(
                task_type=TaskType.TEXT_CLASSIFICATION,
                input_data=text
            )
            
            result = self.process_request(request)
            if result["status"] == "success":
                classification = result["result"][0]
                self.console.print(f"\\n[green]Classification:[/green] {classification['label']} ({classification['score']:.3f})")
            else:
                self.console.print(f"[red]Error: {result['error']}[/red]")
    
    def _handle_summarization(self):
        """Handle text summarization request"""
        text = self.console.input("Enter text to summarize: ")
        if text.strip():
            request = AIRequest(
                task_type=TaskType.SUMMARIZATION,
                input_data=text,
                parameters={"max_length": 130, "min_length": 30}
            )
            
            result = self.process_request(request)
            if result["status"] == "success":
                summary = result["result"][0]["summary_text"]
                self.console.print(f"\\n[green]Summary:[/green] {summary}")
            else:
                self.console.print(f"[red]Error: {result['error']}[/red]")
    
    def _handle_translation(self):
        """Handle translation request"""
        text = self.console.input("Enter text to translate (EN->ID): ")
        if text.strip():
            request = AIRequest(
                task_type=TaskType.TRANSLATION,
                input_data=text
            )
            
            result = self.process_request(request)
            if result["status"] == "success":
                translation = result["result"][0]["translation_text"]
                self.console.print(f"\\n[green]Translation:[/green] {translation}")
            else:
                self.console.print(f"[red]Error: {result['error']}[/red]")

def main():
    """Main entry point"""
    orchestrator = CivilizationOrchestrator()
    
    # Show welcome message
    console.print(Panel(
        "🌟 [bold magenta]THE NEW CIVILIZATION[/bold magenta] 🌟\\n\\n"
        "🚀 Hugging Face Orchestrator Online\\n"
        "🤖 100,000+ Models Available\\n"
        "💰 Revenue Generation Active\\n"
        "📱 Mobile-Optimized Performance",
        title="System Initialized",
        border_style="green"
    ))
    
    # Start interactive mode
    orchestrator.start_interactive_mode()
    
    # Show final stats
    console.print("\\n[yellow]Session Summary:[/yellow]")
    orchestrator.display_status()
    
    console.print("\\n[green]Thank you for using The New Civilization! 🚀[/green]")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
'''

# Create Script 3: ai_model_trainer.py - Comprehensive AI/ML Model Training Pipeline

trainer_script = '''#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
THE NEW CIVILIZATION - AI Model Trainer
Comprehensive AI/ML model training and fine-tuning pipeline

This script provides a complete solution for training, fine-tuning, and optimizing
AI models using the Hugging Face ecosystem with mobile-first optimization.
"""

import os
import sys
import json
import time
import logging
import torch
import numpy as np
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Any, Union, Tuple
from dataclasses import dataclass, asdict
from enum import Enum

import datasets
from datasets import Dataset, DatasetDict, load_dataset
from transformers import (
    AutoTokenizer, AutoModel, AutoModelForSequenceClassification,
    AutoModelForCausalLM, TrainingArguments, Trainer, pipeline,
    EarlyStoppingCallback, get_linear_schedule_with_warmup
)
from transformers.trainer_utils import EvalPrediction
from huggingface_hub import HfApi, login, create_repo, upload_folder
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, precision_recall_fscore_support, classification_report
from rich.console import Console
from rich.table import Table
from rich.panel import Panel
from rich.progress import Progress, SpinnerColumn, TextColumn, BarColumn, TaskProgressColumn

# Configuration
sys.path.append(str(Path.home() / "storage" / "shared" / "the_new_civilization" / "config"))
try:
    from civilization_config import config
except ImportError:
    print("❌ Configuration not found! Run termux_civilization_setup.sh first.")
    sys.exit(1)

console = Console()

class TrainingType(Enum):
    """Available training types"""
    FINE_TUNING = "fine_tuning"
    TRANSFER_LEARNING = "transfer_learning"
    FROM_SCRATCH = "from_scratch"
    DISTILLATION = "distillation"
    FEW_SHOT = "few_shot"

class ModelType(Enum):
    """Supported model types"""
    TEXT_CLASSIFICATION = "text_classification"
    TEXT_GENERATION = "text_generation"
    SEQUENCE_LABELING = "sequence_labeling"
    SUMMARIZATION = "summarization"
    TRANSLATION = "translation"
    QUESTION_ANSWERING = "question_answering"

@dataclass
class TrainingConfig:
    """Training configuration"""
    model_name: str
    model_type: ModelType
    training_type: TrainingType
    dataset_name: Optional[str] = None
    dataset_path: Optional[str] = None
    output_dir: str = "trained_model"
    num_epochs: int = 3
    batch_size: int = 8
    learning_rate: float = 2e-5
    warmup_steps: int = 500
    weight_decay: float = 0.01
    max_seq_length: int = 512
    evaluation_strategy: str = "epoch"
    save_strategy: str = "epoch"
    load_best_model_at_end: bool = True
    metric_for_best_model: str = "eval_loss"
    greater_is_better: bool = False
    early_stopping_patience: int = 2
    fp16: bool = True  # For mobile optimization
    gradient_checkpointing: bool = True  # Memory optimization
    dataloader_num_workers: int = 0  # Mobile compatibility
    
class CivilizationModelTrainer:
    """Advanced model training system for The New Civilization"""
    
    def __init__(self):
        """Initialize the trainer"""
        self.console = console
        self.hf_api = HfApi()
        self.device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        self.training_history = []
        
        # Setup logging
        self._setup_logging()
        
        # Authenticate with Hugging Face
        self._authenticate()
        
        self.logger.info("🚀 AI Model Trainer initialized")
        self.logger.info(f"🔧 Device: {self.device}")
    
    def _setup_logging(self):
        """Setup logging system"""
        log_dir = config.LOGS_DIR
        log_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        
        logging.basicConfig(
            level=logging.INFO,
            format='%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s',
            handlers=[
                logging.FileHandler(log_dir / "trainer.log"),
                logging.StreamHandler()
            ]
        )
        self.logger = logging.getLogger("CivilizationTrainer")
    
    def _authenticate(self):
        """Authenticate with Hugging Face"""
        if config.HF_TOKEN:
            try:
                login(token=config.HF_TOKEN)
                self.logger.info("✅ Authenticated with Hugging Face")
            except Exception as e:
                self.logger.error(f"❌ Authentication failed: {e}")
        else:
            self.logger.warning("⚠️ No HF_TOKEN found - publishing features disabled")
    
    def prepare_dataset(self, training_config: TrainingConfig) -> DatasetDict:
        """Prepare dataset for training"""
        self.logger.info("📊 Preparing dataset...")
        
        try:
            # Load dataset
            if training_config.dataset_name:
                dataset = load_dataset(training_config.dataset_name)
                self.logger.info(f"📥 Loaded dataset: {training_config.dataset_name}")
            elif training_config.dataset_path:
                # Load from local file
                if training_config.dataset_path.endswith('.json'):
                    dataset = Dataset.from_json(training_config.dataset_path)
                elif training_config.dataset_path.endswith('.csv'):
                    dataset = Dataset.from_csv(training_config.dataset_path)
                else:
                    raise ValueError("Unsupported dataset format")
                
                # Split if needed
                if "train" not in dataset:
                    dataset = dataset.train_test_split(test_size=0.2)
                
                self.logger.info(f"📥 Loaded local dataset: {training_config.dataset_path}")
            else:
                # Create sample dataset for demonstration
                dataset = self._create_sample_dataset(training_config.model_type)
                self.logger.info("📥 Created sample dataset")
            
            return dataset
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"❌ Failed to prepare dataset: {e}")
            raise
    
    def _create_sample_dataset(self, model_type: ModelType) -> DatasetDict:
        """Create sample dataset for demonstration"""
        if model_type == ModelType.TEXT_CLASSIFICATION:
            data = {
                "text": [
                    "I love this product! It's amazing.",
                    "This is terrible, I hate it.",
                    "Pretty good, but could be better.",
                    "Excellent quality and service.",
                    "Not worth the money.",
                    "Fantastic experience overall.",
                    "Disappointing results.",
                    "Highly recommended!"
                ],
                "label": [1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 1, 0, 1]  # 1=positive, 0=negative
            }
        elif model_type == ModelType.TEXT_GENERATION:
            data = {
                "text": [
                    "The future of AI is",
                    "In the world of technology",
                    "Machine learning enables",
                    "Artificial intelligence will",
                    "Deep learning algorithms",
                    "Neural networks can"
                ]
            }
        else:
            # Default text classification
            data = {
                "text": ["Sample text for training"],
                "label": [1]
            }
        
        dataset = Dataset.from_dict(data)
        return DatasetDict({
            "train": dataset.select(range(len(data["text"]) // 2)),
            "test": dataset.select(range(len(data["text"]) // 2, len(data["text"])))
        })
    
    def setup_model_and_tokenizer(self, training_config: TrainingConfig) -> Tuple[Any, Any]:
        """Setup model and tokenizer"""
        self.logger.info(f"🤖 Loading model: {training_config.model_name}")
        
        try:
            # Load tokenizer
            tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(training_config.model_name)
            
            # Add pad token if missing
            if tokenizer.pad_token is None:
                tokenizer.pad_token = tokenizer.eos_token
            
            # Load model based on type
            if training_config.model_type == ModelType.TEXT_CLASSIFICATION:
                model = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained(
                    training_config.model_name,
                    num_labels=2  # Binary classification by default
                )
            elif training_config.model_type == ModelType.TEXT_GENERATION:
                model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(training_config.model_name)
            else:
                # Default to auto model
                model = AutoModel.from_pretrained(training_config.model_name)
            
            # Move to device
            model.to(self.device)
            
            self.logger.info(f"✅ Model and tokenizer loaded successfully")
            return model, tokenizer
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"❌ Failed to load model: {e}")
            raise
    
    def preprocess_data(self, dataset: DatasetDict, tokenizer: Any, 
                       training_config: TrainingConfig) -> DatasetDict:
        """Preprocess data for training"""
        self.logger.info("🔄 Preprocessing data...")
        
        def tokenize_function(examples):
            if training_config.model_type == ModelType.TEXT_CLASSIFICATION:
                # Tokenize text for classification
                return tokenizer(
                    examples["text"],
                    truncation=True,
                    padding=True,
                    max_length=training_config.max_seq_length
                )
            elif training_config.model_type == ModelType.TEXT_GENERATION:
                # Tokenize for generation (input = output)
                tokenized = tokenizer(
                    examples["text"],
                    truncation=True,
                    padding=True,
                    max_length=training_config.max_seq_length
                )
                tokenized["labels"] = tokenized["input_ids"].copy()
                return tokenized
            else:
                # Default tokenization
                return tokenizer(
                    examples["text"],
                    truncation=True,
                    padding=True,
                    max_length=training_config.max_seq_length
                )
        
        # Apply preprocessing
        tokenized_dataset = dataset.map(
            tokenize_function,
            batched=True,
            remove_columns=dataset["train"].column_names
        )
        
        self.logger.info("✅ Data preprocessing completed")
        return tokenized_dataset
    
    def setup_training_arguments(self, training_config: TrainingConfig) -> TrainingArguments:
        """Setup training arguments"""
        output_dir = config.MODELS_DIR / training_config.output_dir
        output_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        
        args = TrainingArguments(
            output_dir=str(output_dir),
            num_train_epochs=training_config.num_epochs,
            per_device_train_batch_size=training_config.batch_size,
            per_device_eval_batch_size=training_config.batch_size,
            learning_rate=training_config.learning_rate,
            warmup_steps=training_config.warmup_steps,
            weight_decay=training_config.weight_decay,
            logging_dir=str(config.LOGS_DIR / "tensorboard"),
            logging_steps=10,
            evaluation_strategy=training_config.evaluation_strategy,
            save_strategy=training_config.save_strategy,
            load_best_model_at_end=training_config.load_best_model_at_end,
            metric_for_best_model=training_config.metric_for_best_model,
            greater_is_better=training_config.greater_is_better,
            fp16=training_config.fp16,
            gradient_checkpointing=training_config.gradient_checkpointing,
            dataloader_num_workers=training_config.dataloader_num_workers,
            save_total_limit=2,  # Limit saved checkpoints for storage
            report_to=None,  # Disable wandb/tensorboard for mobile
        )
        
        return args
    
    def compute_metrics(self, eval_pred: EvalPrediction) -> Dict[str, float]:
        """Compute evaluation metrics"""
        predictions, labels = eval_pred
        
        if len(predictions.shape) > 1:
            predictions = np.argmax(predictions, axis=1)
        
        accuracy = accuracy_score(labels, predictions)
        precision, recall, f1, _ = precision_recall_fscore_support(labels, predictions, average='weighted')
        
        return {
            'accuracy': accuracy,
            'f1': f1,
            'precision': precision,
            'recall': recall
        }
    
    def train_model(self, training_config: TrainingConfig) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """Train the model"""
        self.logger.info("🎯 Starting model training...")
        
        training_start = datetime.now()
        
        try:
            # Prepare dataset
            dataset = self.prepare_dataset(training_config)
            
            # Setup model and tokenizer
            model, tokenizer = self.setup_model_and_tokenizer(training_config)
            
            # Preprocess data
            tokenized_dataset = self.preprocess_data(dataset, tokenizer, training_config)
            
            # Setup training arguments
            training_args = self.setup_training_arguments(training_config)
            
            # Create trainer
            trainer = Trainer(
                model=model,
                args=training_args,
                train_dataset=tokenized_dataset["train"],
                eval_dataset=tokenized_dataset.get("test"),
                compute_metrics=self.compute_metrics if training_config.model_type == ModelType.TEXT_CLASSIFICATION else None,
                callbacks=[EarlyStoppingCallback(early_stopping_patience=training_config.early_stopping_patience)]
            )
            
            # Start training
            self.logger.info("🚀 Training started...")
            
            with Progress(
                SpinnerColumn(),
                TextColumn("[progress.description]{task.description}"),
                BarColumn(),
                TaskProgressColumn(),
                console=console
            ) as progress:
                task = progress.add_task("Training model...", total=training_config.num_epochs)
                
                # Train the model
                training_result = trainer.train()
                
                progress.update(task, completed=training_config.num_epochs)
            
            # Save model
            model_path = config.MODELS_DIR / training_config.output_dir / "final"
            model_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            
            trainer.save_model(str(model_path))
            tokenizer.save_pretrained(str(model_path))
            
            training_end = datetime.now()
            training_duration = training_end - training_start
            
            # Evaluate model
            eval_results = trainer.evaluate() if tokenized_dataset.get("test") else {}
            
            # Prepare results
            results = {
                "training_config": asdict(training_config),
                "training_duration": str(training_duration),
                "training_loss": training_result.training_loss,
                "eval_results": eval_results,
                "model_path": str(model_path),
                "timestamp": training_end.isoformat()
            }
            
            # Save results
            self._save_training_results(results)
            
            self.logger.info(f"✅ Training completed in {training_duration}")
            self.logger.info(f"💾 Model saved to: {model_path}")
            
            return results
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"❌ Training failed: {e}")
            raise
    
    def _save_training_results(self, results: Dict[str, Any]):
        """Save training results"""
        results_dir = config.LOGS_DIR / "training_results"
        results_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        
        timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")
        results_file = results_dir / f"training_{timestamp}.json"
        
        with open(results_file, "w") as f:
            json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
        
        self.training_history.append(results)
    
    def publish_to_hub(self, model_path: str, repo_name: str, 
                      description: str = "", private: bool = False) -> str:
        """Publish trained model to Hugging Face Hub"""
        try:
            if not config.HF_TOKEN:
                raise ValueError("HF_TOKEN required for publishing")
            
            self.logger.info(f"📤 Publishing model to Hub: {repo_name}")
            
            # Create repository
            full_repo_name = f"{config.HF_USERNAME}/{repo_name}"
            
            try:
                repo_url = create_repo(
                    repo_id=full_repo_name,
                    token=config.HF_TOKEN,
                    private=private,
                    exist_ok=True
                )
            except Exception as e:
                self.logger.warning(f"Repository may already exist: {e}")
                repo_url = f"https://huggingface.co/{full_repo_name}"
            
            # Upload model
            upload_folder(
                folder_path=model_path,
                repo_id=full_repo_name,
                token=config.HF_TOKEN,
                commit_message=f"Upload {repo_name} model"
            )
            
            self.logger.info(f"✅ Model published: {repo_url}")
            return repo_url
            
        except Exception as e:
            self.logger.error(f"❌ Failed to publish model: {e}")
            raise
    
    def display_training_history(self):
        """Display training history"""
        if not self.training_history:
            console.print("[yellow]No training history available[/yellow]")
            return
        
        table = Table(title="🎯 Training History")
        table.add_column("Model", style="cyan")
        table.add_column("Type", style="blue")
        table.add_column("Duration", style="green")
        table.add_column("Loss", style="yellow")
        table.add_column("Accuracy", style="magenta")
        
        for result in self.training_history[-10:]:  # Show last 10
            config_data = result["training_config"]
            eval_results = result.get("eval_results", {})
            
            table.add_row(
                config_data["model_name"],
                config_data["model_type"],
                result["training_duration"],
                f"{result.get('training_loss', 0):.4f}",
                f"{eval_results.get('eval_accuracy', 0):.3f}"
            )
        
        console.print(table)
    
    def start_interactive_training(self):
        """Start interactive training mode"""
        console.print(Panel(
            "🎯 [bold magenta]THE NEW CIVILIZATION[/bold magenta]\\n"
            "AI Model Training System\\n\\n"
            "Available commands:\\n"
            "• [cyan]quick[/cyan] - Quick training with sample data\\n"
            "• [cyan]custom[/cyan] - Custom training configuration\\n"
            "• [cyan]history[/cyan] - Show training history\\n"
            "• [cyan]publish[/cyan] - Publish model to Hub\\n"
            "• [cyan]quit[/cyan] - Exit",
            title="Training Mode",
            border_style="green"
        ))

        ''', (amount, project_id))
